_comment: Regression plates for the ship masters on exactly flat faces (WORKFLOW dd, dg): left to right in the image = kit trim, layered turned 37 deg, layered flat, PBR tilted 12 deg, PBR turned 37 deg, PBR flat. Default textures, metallic 0: every plate must be lit light grey, a black one means the master breaks on that orientation. Run after Tools/Assets/probe_pbr_flat.py: Tools/Shots.ps1 -Preset probe_pbr_flat -Package
